author: Russell Brand
description:
Dr. Andrew Wakefield recounts how parents began contacting him about children experiencing serious gastrointestinal problems alongside developmental changes they associated with the MMR vaccine. He says his team investigated the children, found inflammatory bowel disease, and observed behavioral changes after treatment.

Wakefield then describes the moment he says a dean warned him that continuing vaccine-safety research would be bad for his career — a warning he says ultimately proved accurate.
